iti51:1.1: (Tik. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me suttaṃ.
iti51:2.1: Tisso imā bhikkhave dhātuyo. Katamā tisso? Rūpadhātu arūpadhātu nirodhadhātu, imā kho bhikkhave tisso dhātuyo ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti51:3.1: Rūpadhātupariññāya arūpesu {susaṇṭhitā} | nirodhe ye vimuccanti te janā maccuhāyino ||
iti51:4.1: Kāyena amataṃ dhātuṃ phassayitvā nirūpadhiṃ | upadhippaṭinissaggaṃ sacchikatvā anāsavo | deseti sammāsambuddho asokaṃ virajaṃ padan-ti ||
iti51:5.1: Aya-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||2|| (Tik.
